intro.text: Placeholder: this review is written by fans, one for each framework. The bias is the point: each one shows what its fans love, then says plainly where it is not as strong.

app.name: team inbox
app.about: One app, written once in each framework from the same spec: 10 000 issues in a virtualised list, search, a validated edit form, a weekly chart, light and dark, English and Japanese. Every implementation was driven by the same scripted session on the same machine.

leptos.code:
<input class="search" type="search" id="search"
    placeholder=move || t_string!(i18n, search_placeholder)
    aria-label=move || t_string!(i18n, search_placeholder)
    prop:value=move || st.query.get()
    on:input=move |e| st.query.set(event_target_value(&e))
    on:keydown=move |e: KeyboardEvent| match e.key().as_str() {
        "Escape" => st.query.set(String::new()),
        "ArrowDown" => {
            e.prevent_default();
            step_cursor(st, 1, true);
            if let Some(el) = by_id("listbox") { let _ = el.focus(); }
        }
        _ => {}
    } />

readonly property string titleError:
    title.text.trim() === "" ? qsTr("Title is required")
    : title.text.length > 120 ? qsTr("At most 120 characters") : ""
readonly property string tagsError:
    words.some(w => !/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(w)) ? qsTr("Tags are lowercase words")
    : words.length > 6 ? qsTr("At most 6 tags") : ""
readonly property string bodyError: body.length > 10000 ? qsTr("At most 10 000 characters") : ""
readonly property bool valid: titleError === "" && tagsError === "" && bodyError === ""

    dTitle = r.title; dTags = (r.tags ?? []).join(" "); dBody = r.body
